title: Means Arms
description:
Means Arms Ammo is a native 320×170 reloading loadbook and ballistics companion built for the CardputerZero's screen and 46-key keyboard (no Fn key needed for navigation).
 Features:
• Caliber Tabs: Browse one caliber at a time with quick horizontal tab switching (Z / C), showing bullet weight, powder charge, powder name, velocity badge, and cost per round in the list view.
• Sort & Search: Sort by Bullet Weight (S:Wt, default) or Load Name (S:Name), or search live across load names, calibers, powders, and bullets (/).
• 4-Tab Load Detail & Inline Editor:
1. Specs: Load name, caliber, Cartridge/Shotshell toggle, Imperial/Metric units,powder charge, COAL, case trim, and bullet/powder/primer/case descriptions.
2. Costs & Savings: Per-round cost breakdown (bullet, powder, primer, case with reuse
count), color-coded cost bar, loads per lb/kg, retail comparison, and a 20–1,000 round savings table.
3. Ballistics: Muzzle velocity (fps / m/s), SD, ES, BC (G1/G7), muzzle energy (ft-lbs), and a 100–500 yd drop table (drop in inches, MOA, MIL, and remaining velocity).
4. Notes: View and edit load notes inline.
• Backup Compatibility: Imports and exports the exact JSON backup format
